title: Concordat: Typed Sessions for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents built on large language models are increasingly allowed to take consequential actions: cancelling bookings, issuing refunds, changing accounts. The rules that govern those actions, such as "obtain the customer's explicit confirmation before changing anything", are usually stated in the prompt and followed only as reliably as the model chooses to follow them. We present Concordat, a Python library that treats an agent as an object whose interface is a finite-state protocol, in the spirit of typestate and session types, and enforces that protocol on the model at run time. On every turn the model is offered only the tools that are legal in the current protocol state, calls outside that set are rejected before they have side effects, decisions reserved for humans can only be requested, and token and tool-call budgets are charged and split linearly across handoffs. Protocols are checked when they are defined, and a subclass of an agent

translated_title: Concordat：面向大语言模型智能体的类型化会话
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型构建的智能体越来越多地被允许执行具有实际后果的操作：取消预订、发放退款、更改账户。约束这些操作的规则，例如“在更改任何内容之前必须获得客户的明确确认”，通常只是写在提示词中，其被遵守的可靠程度完全取决于模型自身的选择。我们提出了 Concordat，这是一个 Python 库，它借鉴类型状态与会话类型的思想，将智能体视为一个接口为有限状态协议的对象，并在运行时对模型强制执行该协议。在每一轮交互中，模型只会被提供当前协议状态下合法的工具，超出该集合的调用会在产生副作用之前被拒绝，保留给人类的决策只能被请求（而不能被模型擅自执行），并且令牌与工具调用预算会被计量并在任务交接时线性分摊。协议在定义时即接受检查，智能体的子类……（原文摘要至此中断）
tldr: Concordat 是一个 Python 库，它借鉴类型状态与会话类型的思想，将大语言模型智能体的接口建模为有限状态协议并在运行时强制执行，每一轮只向模型提供当前状态下合法的工具，从而用类型化的结构性保障取代仅靠提示词约束智能体行为的脆弱做法。
en_tdlr: Concordat is a Python library that models LLM agents as objects whose interface is a finite-state protocol, in the spirit of typestate and session types, and enforces the protocol at runtime by offering the model only the tools legal in the current state, replacing fragile prompt-based rules with type-checked, structurally guaranteed agent behavior.
